title: Laboratory Operator I, II, & III
text:
The  Emerald Cloud Laboratory  (ECL) enables life scientists to move out of the lab, and to conduct research entirely from a computer. Stepping away from manual completion of experiments at the bench, scientists on the ECL leverage the remote, automated execution of all standard biology and chemistry experiments in Emerald’s industrial lab facilities, working within a software platform for all stages of research workflows, from experimental design to data analysis. Our system empowers scientists at Big Pharma companies, startups, and academic laboratories by allowing them to run wet lab experiments from anywhere in the world without ever stepping foot into the lab.
The demand for our service is growing, and to meet that demand, we are recruiting Lab Operators looking to explore opportunities in the biotech space and grow with our organization. Qualified candidates will receive comprehensive lab and safety training, allowing them the ability to run protocols in our Austin facility. These protocols are critical to sustaining the high-quality operations of the facility and provide experience working in ECL’s unique, process-driven lab environment with our integrated software tools.
These are contract positions with a potential to convert to full-time ECL employees subject to meeting performance metrics.
The ideal candidate will possess the following skills:
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced production, fulfillment, or manufacturing environments with defined success metrics and goals for teams and individuals
- Ability to follow detailed written instruction required to successfully run stated protocols with minimal supervision
- Keen attention to detail, highly organized, and diligent
- Understands and follows all ECL and site-specific policies and procedures.
- Willing to participate in continuous improvement and operation exercises
- Strong computer skills and not intimidated to learn new systems.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Ability to handle and maneuver small components and parts
- Comply with all lab safety guidelines and use appropriate safety and protected devices when performing duties in the lab
- Ability to work flexible shifts/hours ( 12.5 hours per day ) , as well as overtime as needed, which requires standing on lab floor for the duration of a work shift not including breaks.
- Lifting and handling of materials used for experiments will be required, not to exceed OSHA guidelines
This role requires the operation of specific laboratory equipment that may pose safety hazards to individuals with certain medical conditions or implanted metal devices. Please consult with a healthcare provider if you have concerns about safely performing these tasks.
Preferred Skills & Experience:
- 1 - 3 years of experience working in either a laboratory environment or regulated manufacturing industry (Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, Biotechnology, Automotive, etc.)
- Experience working in a Good Manufacturing Practices/Good Laboratory Practices (GMP/GLP) environment
This is a non-exempt, contract-to-FTE role, with openings available for day & night shifts and the ability to start immediately. The hourly rate for this role is $20 - $26 per hour, depending on the experience.
Upon conversion to an ECL employee you will be provided competitive wages, stock options, and employee health benefits.
Applying
We’d love to hear from you!  Please follow the "Apply" link below, and include your resume and a remark or two about where you are coming from and why you are interested in Emerald and this role.
At Emerald Cloud Lab, we are committed to pioneering the future of scientific research by providing an innovative, cloud-based laboratory environment. We believe in the power of collaboration, diversity, and the continuous pursuit of knowledge to drive groundbreaking discoveries. If you are passionate about reshaping the landscape of scientific experimentation and eager to contribute to a culture of excellence and innovation, we invite you to join us.
Emerald Cloud Lab is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities or medical conditions. If you have any concerns about your ability to perform the essential functions of the role or need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know. We will work with you to ensure you have the necessary support to fully participate in our hiring process.

title: Laboratory Operations Shift Manager
text:
The Team
The Laboratory Operations (LabOps) team is charged with executing the logistical aspects of our laboratory processes. All scientifically relevant aspects of each experiment are executed using robotics and automation, and it is the job of LabOps to set up and maintain the robotic instrumentation on which the entire lab runs. The LabOps team relentlessly clears the queue of customer and internal experiments and keeps the automated instrumentation running at all times while focusing on precision and efficiency. The entire CMU Cloud Lab facility is run in a systematic way and the team's purview encompasses all experiments that enable this, from maintenance and control of instruments to inventory intake and receiving. The LabOps team interfaces with many teams at the CMU Cloud Lab which rely on the Operations team to be the voice of high-quality feedback as they seek to streamline the internal systems on which the Cloud Lab runs.
The Position
As a Shift Manager, you will be responsible for managing a shift of approximately 15-20 individuals. As the leader of this team, you will be responsible for setting high standards for your shift while ensuring all performance metrics are met on time and within cost. In this role you’ll act as a key business partner to operations leadership and cross-functional partners, assisting with driving efficiency and implementing scalable processes. This position requires a results-oriented, high-energy individual with the stamina and mental agility to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.
General Duties and Responsibilities
- Supervise a shift consisting of approximately 15-20 people while ensuring all company performance metrics are met.
- Plan, direct, supervise and control the execution of all business, technical, and fiscal functions of the Lab Operations department as deemed necessary by senior leadership.
- Manage daily work in the facility and monitor the queue of experiments to ensure that all protocols are addressed in a timely manner.
- Ensure that work produced by shift members is in accordance with company standards.
- Track and manage operator performance, attendance, training, and career development.
- Serve as the point person for any questions that arise on shift.
- Enforce facility policies and procedures including those involving safety and compliance.
- Staffing, scheduling, and approving timecards.
- Maintaining a safe and clean workspace
- Effectively work with other Shift Managers to ensure a smooth transition of shifts in a 24/7 environment.
- All other duties as deemed necessary.
About You
The ideal candidate will possess the following skills:
- A servant leadership mindset
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced fulfillment, production, or manufacturing environment with defined success metrics
- A demonstrated history of success as leader of small and mid-sized teams
- Exceptional project management skills
- Ability to follow detailed written instructions.
- Excellent communication skills with all levels of management and staff
- Keen attention to detail, highly organized, and diligent
- Ability to work a flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays.
- The ability to take the initiative in problem-solving with minimal supervision.
Preferred Skills & Experience
- 1- 4 years of leadership experience working in either:
- A fast-paced fulfillment center environment (Warehouse, Third Party Logistics, etc)
- A regulated manufacturing industry (Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, Biotechnology, Automotive, etc)
- Clinical testing labs or hospital
- Bachelors or master’s degree in industrial engineering or Operations Management
- Six Sigma Certification (Green or Black Belt)
- Experience with Lean Manufacturing or Toyota Production System principles
About ECL
www.emeraldcloudlab.com
The Emerald Cloud Laboratory (ECL) enables life scientists to move out of the lab, and to conduct research entirely from a computer. Stepping away from manual completion of experiments at the bench, scientists on the ECL leverage the remote, automated execution of all standard biology and chemistry experiments in Emerald’s industrial lab facilities, working within a software platform for all stages of research workflows, from experimental design to data analysis.

title: Senior HR Generalist
text:
About the Role
Emerald Cloud Laboratory (ECL) is seeking an experienced, hands-on HR Generalist to support employees and managers in a fast-paced startup environment.
Reporting to the Head of HR, you’ll manage day-to-day HR operations, including employee relations, manager support, benefits, leaves, onboarding, offboarding, compliance, and employee documentation. The ideal candidate is approachable, organized, responsive, and comfortable handling sensitive matters with sound judgment and confidentiality.
What You’ll Do
- Serve as a trusted HR resource for employees and managers.
- Manage employee relations concerns, workplace investigations, and conflict resolution.
- Coach managers on performance, documentation, corrective action, and terminations.
- Coordinate onboarding, offboarding, and employee changes.
- Maintain accurate HRIS data and confidential employee records.
- Support benefits, open enrollment, leaves, and workplace accommodations.
- Partner with payroll to ensure employee information is accurate and timely.
- Interpret and consistently apply employment laws and company policies.
- Support performance reviews, employee engagement, reporting, and HR projects.
- Identify risks and escalate significant concerns to the Head of HR.
What You’ll Bring
- Six or more years of progressive HR experience, preferably in an HR Generalist role.
- Strong employee relations, investigation, and manager-coaching experience.
- Experience with benefits, leaves, onboarding, offboarding, HRIS administration, and payroll support.
- Working knowledge of federal, state, and local employment laws.
- Strong communication, organization, judgment, and confidentiality.
- Experience in a startup, biotechnology, scientific, or technical environment is preferred.
- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field is preferred.
- Ability to work in the Austin office one day per week.
If you’re a solutions-oriented HR professional who enjoys supporting employees and partnering with managers, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Legal Counsel
text:
Emerald Cloud Lab (ECL) is the world's leading remote life sciences laboratory, allowing scientists to run experiments 24/7/365, from anywhere in the world, revolutionizing the approach to lab work for research, product development and QC testing. The entire lab is driven through a single software interface, forming one continuous workflow from test design to execution in the lab and analysis of resulting data. Scientific methods are translated into code, then executed in our state-of-the art laboratory. With ECL handling the manual completion of experiments, scientists can spend more time on the science - designing experiments and interpreting results.
About the Role
Emerald Cloud Lab is seeking a resourceful, business-minded Corporate Counsel to join its legal team, reporting directly to the General Counsel. This role provides broad, hands-on legal support across the company's commercial, product, and corporate operations. You will partner closely with engineering, product, sales, and business teams to help the company build and scale responsibly, drafting and negotiating commercial agreements, supporting corporate governance, and managing legal risk in a fast-moving technology environment. This is an excellent opportunity for a pragmatic attorney seeking broad exposure to technology law and a growth path within an in-house legal function.
Key Responsibilities
- Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, including customer agreements, vendor and procurement contracts, NDAs, partnership agreements, and licensing arrangements.
- Advise internal stakeholders (sales, product, engineering, marketing, HR) on day-to-day legal questions, escalating novel or high-risk issues to the General Counsel.
- Contribute to the development and maintenance of internal legal playbooks, templates, policies, and processes to help the legal function scale efficiently.
- Assist with the legal aspects of fundraising, M&A due diligence, and other strategic transactions as they arise.
- Help manage outside counsel on specialized or high-volume matters, ensuring efficient and cost-effective use of external resources.
Potential Supplemental Responsibilities
- Support internal Quality Team developing innovating next generation FDA GxP compliance program
- Support data privacy and security compliance efforts (e.g., GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) in partnership with the security and engineering teams.
- Assist with intellectual property matters, including trademark and copyright protection, open-source software usage review, and IP assignment agreements.
- Support corporate governance matters, including board materials, subsidiary management, and corporate recordkeeping.
- Support employment-related matters and policies in coordination with People/HR, as needed.
Qualifications
- D. from an accredited law school and an active license to practice law (or eligibility to register as in-house/corporate counsel in the relevant jurisdiction).
- 3-10 years of relevant legal experience, ideally including a mix of law firm and in-house experience.
- Strong drafting and negotiation skills, with demonstrated experience handling commercial contracts independently.
- General familiarity with IP and technology licensing concepts.
- Ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, practical guidance for non-legal business partners.
- Strong judgment and comfort operating with a degree of ambiguity in a fast-paced, resource-constrained environment.
- Excellent communication, organization, and project management skills.
- A collaborative, service-oriented mindset and a genuine interest in learning the company's business.
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience negotiating large procurement contracts in the life sciences industry.
- Experience supporting a B2B SaaS or enterprise software business.
- Prior experience managing outside counsel relationships and legal spend.
- Familiarity with legal or regulatory considerations in life sciences, laboratory services, or other regulated industries (e.g., FDA, GMP) is a strong plus, but not required.
What We Offer
- Competitive salary and equity compensation.
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.
- Additional benefits, including PTO, 401(k), and a professional development stipend.
- Direct mentorship from the General Counsel and meaningful ownership over your practice area.
Emerald Cloud Lab is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Construction Project Director
text:
Construction Project Director
The Construction Project Director will lead all aspects of ECL's construction initiatives: existing site expansion; construction of new sites; and offsite fabrication of custom fixtures, necessary to attach our equipment into the cloud lab. In this role, you'll ove rsee E CL's own projects (like expanding our flagship facility in Austin, TX), and will act as a liaison to our clients, supplying guidance and project oversight as they build t heir own cloud labs. The Construction Project Director will also work with contract manufacturers to build supply chains, fabrication, logistics , an d install ation support for ECL-designed fixtures.
This role can be seated in Austin as a hybrid role; or anywhere in the US, with the expectation of regular travel to ECL and client sites (up to 25%).
Key Responsibilities
Austin Facility Expansion
- Oversee day-to-day construction of the Austin facility expansion, directing general contractors, subcontractors, and vendors
- Work with the VP of Special Projects to manage project schedule and budget
- Coordinate with Owners-Rep to represent Emerald at regular owner-architect-contractor (OAC) meetings and report progress, risks, and mitigation plans to senior leadership
- Coordinate design reviews, RFIs, submittals, and value-engineering efforts with the architect, engineers, and internal stakeholders
- Manage QA and QC, incl. punch lists, commissioning, closeout documentation, and turnover to operations, with special attention to Change Control and Risk Assessment in a GMP lab
- Capture lessons learned from the Austin build and feed them back into the company’s architectural program and construction standards
Client Construction Support
- Serve as the primary point of contact for clients building facilities based on ECL's architectural program, from pre-construction through commissioning
- Guide clients and their internal teams on correct implementation of the program
- Review client drawings, specifications, schedules, and submittals for conformance with the program
- Conduct site visits and progress reviews at client projects
- Develop and maintain client-facing resources (implementation guides, checklists, standard details, etc.)
- Identify opportunities to supply company-fabricated MEP equipment to client projects, working with sales and leadership on scoping and proposals
Offsite Fixture Fabrication
- Identify domestic contract manufacturers with the necessary capabilities to fabricate large MEP fixtures based on ECL's existing designs, and coordinate with internal stakeholders to select the best one
- Manage relationship with selected contract manufacturer
- Develop cost-effective logistics options to transport fixtures to construction sites
- Coordinate with site general contractors – whether our own or client – to have the appropriate trades available to install required fixtures
- Liaise with contract manufacturer, in-house design, and on-site installers to improve and refine the design and fabrication of the fixtures
General
- Collaborate with internal teams and executive leadership on long-term facility and growth planning
- Champion continuous improvement in construction methods, standardization, and prefabrication
Qualifications
Required
- Bachelor's degree in Construction Management or a related field, and  5+ years of experience; OR, High school diploma or equivalent, and  10+ years of experience
- At least 5 years of commercial/industrial construction management experience
- Experience leading at least one $10,000,000+ construction project
- Experience managing ground-up or major construction from pre-construction through closeout
- Strong working knowledge of MEP systems and their design, installation, and commissioning
- Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and shop drawings
- Working knowledge of building codes, OSHA requirements, and permitting processes
- Proficiency with construction management and scheduling tools
- Willingness to travel 25% to client project sites
Preferred
- Experience with MEP prefabrication, modular construction, or off-site manufacturing
- Background in repeatable or prototype-based building programs
- Experience in lab construction
- Familiarity with UL 508A, ASME, NFPA 70/NEC, or other standards relevant to fabricated equipment
- PMP, CCM, or similar professional certification; PE license a plus
- OSHA 30 certification
- Experience with design-build or integrated project delivery
- Experience with BIM/VDC tools (e.g., Revit, Navisworks)

title: Senior Backend Engineer
text:
Staff Backend Engineer
About the Role
We are seeking a Senior Platform Software Engineer to join our platform team and help build the services that power the future of scientific research. You will develop and maintain critical APIs and services that enable scientists to orchestrate complex experiments remotely. This role offers the unique opportunity to solve challenging problems at the intersection of cloud computing, laboratory automation, and scientific instrumentation.
You will join a small, high-impact team where ownership and leadership are essential. As a team member helping to build the Engineering team as well as the product, you will also be encouraged to contribute to the software engineering practices we maintain in our own work, and which we bring to ECL as a whole. We strive to be continually critical of our process, cutting cruft and homing in on performance multipliers (such as continuous integration and agile development practices).
In this role you will
- Design and develop highly scalable backend services, ensuring performance and security
- Collaborate with designers, scientists and engineers to deliver products solving real challenges experienced in labs by our users
- Help set technical and product direction, collaborating with the team to determine the future of the product, what features to build, and how to build them
- Ensure continual, high-availability operation of our services using modern reliability practices, including detailed observability and participation in an on-call rotation
- Participate in code reviews and troubleshoot any performance or security issues
- Advocate for healthy and maintainable software practices
-
Examples of projects
- Improving our hybrid object / graph multi-tenant data store that supports describing all standard biology and chemistry experiments in code
- Develop new services to gather real time data from sensors in our lab and make them available to operators for live feedback and to our cloud for further processing and aggregation
- Building a service to safely distribute and execute simulation, analysis, and testing code in SLL
- Working closely with our Scientific Development team in developing and optimizing data storage, retrieval and search functions in SLL
Our Tech Stack
Our backend services are written in Go, Python or Rust, and deployed on AWS infrastructure in Docker containers, with container orchestration through Kubernetes. Our applications are web apps (React / HTML5 / CSS3) running on the desktop through NW.js , across Windows and Mac OS. Our source code control is on Github, with integration with Travis CI for continuous testing. The Symbolic Lab Language is written in the Wolfram Language.
More broadly, developing the software to enable cloud-based science is an expansive, diverse challenge. A core component of our job is consistently determining the right tools for the job at hand, and diving in to learn these new technologies along the way.
Requirements
- 8+ years of experience providing backend development to products and enterprise software
- 6+ years in Cloud or AWS hands on development
- Experience with database technologies (SQL or NoSQL)
- Experience working with startups or small growing companies.
- Full life cycle experience with software product development
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Kubernetes and Docker for containerization
- Experience with distributed systems
- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern build tooling
- Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), containers, and observability

title: Director, Compliance & Quality Systems
text:
Director, Compliance & Quality Systems
Role Summary
The Director, Compliance & Quality Systems owns ECL's Quality Management System (QMS). You will play an key role in finalizing the design, build, and implementation of the ECL QMS—a critical step toward GMP compliance—and you'll lead ECL through its first client audits and regulatory inspections. Once the QMS is established, you will oversee everyday operations and continuous compliance.
ECL operates from a single site today and will expand to additional sites in the near future .  You'll ensure the QMS is designed to scale, so all sites launch with the same quality standard. You'll build and lead a focused team to drive GMP compliance.
This hands-on leadership role offers the opportunity to shape ECL's QMS, embedding quality processes directly into ECL's novel software-driven laboratory platform. We're looking for a leader with deep complia nce expertise, as well as the  curiosity and agility to reimagine how those requirements are met in a software-driven, connected environment.
Key Responsibilities
QMS Ownership:
- Own ECL's QMS processes end to end: document control, deviations, OOS, CAPA, change control, risk management, equipment qualification, supplier quality and GMP training
- Monitor QMS execution at current and future sites through quality metrics, periodic reviews, and internal audits
- Ensure the ECL QMS meets client quality requirements and the terms of each Quality Agreement, and that required client notifications are communicated accurately and on time
- Ensure quality and compliance requirements are embedded in ECL's single software platform
- Run Quality Management Reviews and report quality performance, risks, and resource needs to the executive team
Regulatory Intelligence and Readiness:
- Track changes in applicable regulations, guidance and standards and assess their impact on ECL operations and client work
- Monitor inspection trends, warning letters and enforcement themes, & translate them into concrete readiness actions
- Represent ECL's quality and compliance position with external stakeholders
Audits and Inspections
- Own the internal audit program, extending it to each new site as it opens
- Coordinate responses to observations and findings and track them to on-time closure
- Maintain continuous inspection readiness
- Manage client quality agreements and support client qualification questionnaires and due diligence
Supplier Quality
- Own supplier quality program: risk-based supplier selection, qualification, approved supplier list and ongoing performance monitoring
- Plan and conduct supplier audits; manage supplier corrective actions and change notifications
- Establish and maintain quality agreements with critical suppliers of instruments, reagents, consumables and services
Training
- Own the GMP training program at current and future sites
- Deliver quality, data integrity, and inspection-readiness training, u pdating  content as regulations and procedures change
Leadership
- Build and lead a focused team supporting QMS and related activities
- Partner closely with the Quality leadership on strategy, priorities, and escalations
Qualifications
Required:
- Bachelor's degree in  life sciences, chemistry, engineering, or related field
- 10+ years in quality assurance or compliance in a regulated laboratory, CDMO or biopharma environment
- 3+ years leading QA or QC teams
- Deep working knowledge of GMP requirements, including 21 CFR Parts 210/211 and data integrity expectations (21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA+)
- Direct experience in regulatory inspections and client audits, and writing responses that closed findings
- Experience with an internal audit program, supplier quality program and/or a GMP training program
Preferred
- Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in a scientific discipline
- Experience with ISO 9001 and/or ISO/IEC 17025
- Experience with computerized system validation (GAMP 5) and highly automated or software-driven lab operations
- Working knowledge of software development, such as coding, the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and version control
- Quality certification such as ASQ CQA, CQE or CMQ/OE
- Experience in a contract service organization supporting clients with differing quality requirements

title: Alliance Manager
text:
Alliance Manager
The Emerald Cloud Laboratory (ECL) enables life scientists to move out of the lab, and to conduct research entirely from a computer. Stepping away from manual completion of experiments at the bench, scientists on the ECL leverage the remote, automated execution of all standard biology and chemistry experiments in Emerald’s industrial lab facilities, working within a software platform for all stages of research workflows, from experimental design to data analysis. Our system empowers scientists at Big Pharma companies, startups, and academic laboratories by allowing them to run wet lab experiments from anywhere in the world without ever stepping foot into the lab.
This is where you come in! The Alliance Manager will be responsible for overseeing ECL's strategic customer relationships, driving revenue performance and account growth, and ensuring the long-term success of existing customer partnerships. Reporting directly to the CEO, this individual will lead the Technical Account Management team, providing strategic direction and oversight to support customer adoption, satisfaction, and retention. The Alliance Manager will serve as a key liaison between customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring commercial objectives are met while identifying opportunities to expand ECL's presence across existing customer organizations.
Core Responsibilities
- Own and oversee ECL's strategic customer relationships following contract execution, ensuring strong customer engagement, satisfaction, retention, and long-term partnership development
- Drive revenue performance across existing customer accounts, maintaining accountability for achieving contractual revenue expectations and identifying opportunities to improve account performance

- Identify and advance new business opportunities within existing customer organizations, including expansion into additional departments, business units, and research programs, with a focus on generating incremental revenue
- Cultivate and maintain relationships with key customer stakeholders, including scientific leadership, operational decision-makers, and executive sponsors, to strengthen partnerships and support account expansion
- Provide full leadership and oversight of ECL's Technical Account Management team, including establishing performance expectations, setting priorities, coaching and  development, performance management, and ensuring accountability for customer success objectives.
- Oversee customer onboarding, platform adoption, and ongoing account engagement through the Technical Account Management team, ensuring customers effectively leverage ECL's capabilities and receive consistent support
- Serve as a senior escalation point for strategic customer matters, coordinating with Scientific, Engineering, Operations, and other internal teams to resolve challenges, manage customer expectations, and protect the overall customer relationship
- Partner with Business Development on account expansion initiatives, providing customer insights, supporting commercial discussions, and contributing to proposals and contract negotiations as appropriate, while Business Development retains primary ownership of commercial agreements
- Develop and maintain account strategies, performance metrics, and reporting practices that provide leadership with visibility into revenue performance, customer relationship health, expansion opportunities, and potential risks
- Identify and implement improvements to account management practices, internal coordination, and customer engagement strategies to strengthen the overall customer experience and support ECL's continued growth
Qualifications
- Advanced degree in Chemistry, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences (specifically in product development or quality), or a related scientific discipline preferred; equivalent relevant industry experience may be considered
- At least ten (10) years of progressive experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or broader life sciences industries, including scientific leadership, strategic account management, business development, or related functions
- Demonstrated experience leading scientific, technical, or customer-facing teams, including setting strategic priorities, managing performance, and developing employees
- Strong understanding of pharmaceutical research, analytical development, quality control, product development, or related scientific operations, with the ability to engage effectively with scientific and executive stakeholders
- Proven ability to develop and maintain strategic relationships, navigate complex enterprise organizations, and influence decision-making across multiple departments and leadership levels
- Strong commercial acumen, including the ability to assess revenue performance, identify
business opportunities, and drive account growth and long-term partnership
development
- Excellent communication, strategic planning, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to exercise independent judgment and collaborate effectively across scientific, operational, and commercial functions
You might resonate with the culture at ECL if…
- You are passionate about science, technology, and medicine
- You are impressively empathetic
- You first understand the other until they agree you can express their view as well as they can themselves
- You are intellectually fearless. Stretching yourself well out of your comfort zone across multiple disciplines is more the rule than the exception at Emerald
- You are curious. When first-principles reasoning illuminates a path that diverges from the standard assumptions, you feel compelled to see where it leads

title: FP&A Manager
text:
Job Description – FP&A Manager
Emerald Cloud Lab (ECL) is the world's leading remote life sciences laboratory, allowing scientists to run experiments 24/7/365, from anywhere in the world, revolutionizing the approach to lab work for research, product development and QC testing. The entire lab is driven through a single software interface, forming one continuous workflow from test design to execution in the lab and analysis of resulting data. Scientific methods are translated into code, then executed in our state-of-the art laboratory. With ECL handling the manual completion of experiments, scientists can spend more time on the science - designing experiments and interpreting results.
About the Role
The FP&A Manager will join our tight-knit, high-impact Finance team, owning forecasting, cost modeling, capacity planning, and more for both Emerald’s internal operations and Emerald’s clients. We’re looking for an FP&A Manager who brings agility and collaborative acumen to their role: you’re as comfortable working deeply in Excel work to build pricing models as you are having strategic conversations with executive leadership and clients. As a senior individual contributor, the FP&A Manager will work with expertise, autonomy, and a high level of attention to detail.
This role can be performed remotely in the United States, or as a hybrid role based in our Austin flagship facility.
Key Responsibilities
Client Forecast Models and Pricing
- Build client estimates for new opportunities, translating scope (number of methods, run volumes, instruments, timelines) into cost, price and margin
- Partner with sales, operations and scientific teams to gather scope assumptions and pressure-test them
- Support term sheet and contract negotiations with pricing analysis: rate cards, price-reset mechanics, escalators, pass-through costs and fee structures
- Maintain a library of standard pricing and cost templates so estimates are fast and consistent with enterprise financial returns requirements
Cost Modeling
- Build and maintain unit cost models, including labor, materials, instrument support, maintenance and calibration, and facility and overhead allocations
- Benchmark labor costs against relevant market rates and track how automation and cost effiencey change cost per run over time
- Model the cost of standing up capacity: lab hubs, instrument fleets, staffing ramps and new geographies (including international locations)
Capacity planning
- Build and own ECL's capacity model: instrument hours, utilization, staffing by role and shift, and throughput per method and run
- Turn client forecasts and the sales pipeline into capacity needs (headcount, instruments, lab space) and the timing to have them in place
- Tie capacity to pricing: confirm we can deliver the volumes we quote in sales models and contracts, and show how utilization drives unit cost and margin
- Support build-out plans for new lab hubs, instrument lines and locations, including hiring ramps
Profit and scenario modeling
- Build deal-level and portfolio-level P&L models covering the full life of long-term client contracts
- Run scenario and sensitivity analysis on the levers that matter: volumes, productivity gains, labor inflation, price resets, utilization and ramp timing
- Quantify trade-offs in proposed contract terms (for example, who captures productivity savings, CPI-based adjustments, fixed versus variable fees) so leadership can negotiate from the numbers
- Support capital planning and investment cases for new capabilities and R&D funded through pricing
Reporting and insight
- Track actual deal performance against price model and pricing assumptions; close the loop so future estimates improve
- Contribute to budgeting, forecasting and month-end variance analysis alongside the controller and accounting team as needed
What you bring
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or a related field
- 5+ years in FP&A, pricing, corporate finance, consulting or investment banking, with significant ownership of financial models
- Experience in life sciences, pharmaceutical, or related industry
- Expert-level Excel / Google Sheets modeling
- Experience with cost modeling, unit economics and deal or pricing analysis
- Strong grasp of P&L, cost accounting and margin analysis
- Ability to turn incomplete or shifting scope into a defensible estimate, and to clearly state the assumptions behind it
- Comfort working directly with non-finance partners (scientists, operations, sales) and presenting to senior leaders
Nice-to-Have
- Experience with Power BI, or similar
- Experience with Wolfram Mathematica
What We Offer
- Competitive salary and equity compensation.
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.
- Additional benefits, including PTO, 401(k), and a professional development stipend.
- Direct mentorship from leadership and meaningful ownership over your practice area.
Emerald Cloud Lab is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
